reason: I already scroll the group chat at night and my admin sorts the receipts when she gets to it. Paying $19 every month for a bot to do what she already does doesn't feel needed for a café.
objection: $19 a month for something my admin already does. And a café makes a lot of small receipts, so 100 documents might run out and push me to $45.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 40 documents caught a duplicate or a padded receipt my admin missed, I would see it pays for itself and sign up.
